items.title: Helen Oakley Dance interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: And I’d been listening to Basie and Basie, they were very kind, Basie and Prez, and Bas’ said, “This gal is the gal that’s writing in Down Beat.”

ctx.x: I think I wrote it up in Down Beat and I said it was a tie, and I was afraid that the musicians there would doubt it. But it went over as a tie you know. And after that, so that went very well, and built Chick, and he went into the Paramount Hotel and so on and so on. He was desperately ill all the time, but he used to faint after. He played five shows at the Paramount a day, and he would faint. He was — loss of blood and everything. But he was so game. So after that, you know, we said what’s next. And I don’t…
Are you talking about Earle Warren?
